name: AR_TRX_SUMMARY
description: This table stores the fields, such as 'Total Invoices Value', 'Total Invoices Count', 'Total Cash Receipts Value', etc., that require summarization for a specified period of time.  The lowest level of granularity at which the data can be stored and retrieved from this table is as of a specified date for a given currency at a specified 'BILL_TO' location for a specific account of a party.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Customer Account Identifier

columns.name: SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Site Use Identifier

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CURRENCY
columns.description: Currency code

columns.name: AS_OF_DATE
columns.description: Specific date for which the current summary record has been created.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OP_BAL_HIGH_WATERMARK
columns.description: This column value contains the highest Open Receivables Balance for the specific Account, Site, Currency and date (identified by as_of_date). The Open Receivables Balance is calculated by summing the amount_due_remaining on the payment schedules of all the debit items and unresolved cash on all cash receipts.

columns.name: OP_BAL_HIGH_WATERMARK_DATE
columns.description: Highest open receivables balance, which is the sum of the amount_due_remaining on the payment schedules of the debit items and unresolved cash on all cash receipts, for a specific account, site, currency, and date.

columns.name: TOTAL_CASH_RECEIPTS_VALUE
columns.description: Sum of the amounts of all Cash Receipts for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: TOTAL_CASH_RECEIPTS_COUNT
columns.description: Count of payment schedules (installments) of all Chargebacks for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: TOTAL_INVOICES_VALUE
columns.description: Sum of the amount_due_original on payment schedules (installments) of all Invoices for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: TOTAL_INVOICES_COUNT
columns.description: Count of the payment schedules (installments) of all Invoices for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: INV_PAID_AMOUNT
columns.description: Sum of the total amount paid against closed invoices for a specific Account, Site, Currency and as of a given date.

columns.name: INV_INST_PMT_DAYS_SUM
columns.description: Summation of the product of number of days that it took to make payments against invoice installments and the paid amount for a specific Account, Site, Currency and a date i.e.(amount_applied*(apply_date - due_date)).

columns.name: TOTAL_BILLS_RECEIVABLES_VALUE
columns.description: Sum of the original amount of all bills receivable in a particular currency and on a particular date that belong to one customer site.

columns.name: TOTAL_BILLS_RECEIVABLES_COUNT
columns.description: Number of bills receivable in a particular currency and on a particular date that belong to one customer site.

columns.name: TOTAL_CREDIT_MEMOS_VALUE
columns.description: Sum of the amount_due_original on payment schedules (installments) of all Credit Memos for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: TOTAL_CREDIT_MEMOS_COUNT
columns.description: Count of payment schedules (installments) of all Credit Memos for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: TOTAL_DEBIT_MEMOS_VALUE
columns.description: Sum of the amount_due_original on payment schedules (installments) of all Debit Memos for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: TOTAL_DEBIT_MEMOS_COUNT
columns.description: Count of payment schedules (installments) of all Debit Memos for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: TOTAL_CHARGEBACK_VALUE
columns.description: Sum of the AMOUNT_DUE_ORIGINAL on payment schedules (installments) of all chargebacks for the specific customer account, site, currency and date.

columns.name: TOTAL_CHARGEBACK_COUNT
columns.description: This column value contains a count of the payment schedules (installments) of all chargebacks for the specific customer account, site, currency and date.

columns.name: TOTAL_EARNED_DISC_VALUE
columns.description: Sum of the Earned Discounts that were given on the closed payment schedules (installments) of all invoices for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: TOTAL_EARNED_DISC_COUNT
columns.description: Sum of the Earned Discounts that were given on the closed payment schedules (installments) of all invoices for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: TOTAL_UNEARNED_DISC_VALUE
columns.description: Sum of the Unearned Discounts that was given on the closed payment schedules (installments) of all invoices for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: TOTAL_UNEARNED_DISC_COUNT
columns.description: Count of the Unearned Discounts that were given on the closed payment schedules (installments) of all invoices for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: TOTAL_ADJUSTMENTS_VALUE
columns.description: Sum of the adjustment amounts on the payment schedules of all the debit items for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date (identified by as_of_date column).  Special adjustments, such as Adjustment Reversal, are not included because they are used for internal accounting purposes only.

columns.name: TOTAL_ADJUSTMENTS_COUNT
columns.description: Count of the adjustments on the payment schedules of all the debit items for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date. Special adjustments, such as Adjustment Reversal are not included.

columns.name: TOTAL_DEPOSITS_VALUE
columns.description: Sum of the amount_due_original on payment schedules (installments) of all Deposits for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: TOTAL_DEPOSITS_COUNT
columns.description: Count of payment schedules (installments) of all Deposits for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: SUM_APP_AMT_DAYS_LATE
columns.description: Summation of the product of amount applied and the difference in apply date and due date for all the cash receipt applications against the Invoices Installments for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date i.e. (amount_applied*(apply_date - due_date)).

columns.name: SUM_APP_AMT
columns.description: Sum of the amount applied against the closed payment schedules (installments) of all the Invoices for the specific Account, Site, Currency and date.

columns.name: COUNT_OF_TOT_INV_INST_PAID
columns.description: Count of the payment schedules (installments), that have been paid off completely, i.e., status = CL, of all Invoices for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: COUNT_OF_INV_INST_PAID_LATE
columns.description: Count of the payment schedules (installments) that have been paid late, i.e., status = CL and actual_date_closed > due_date of all Invoices for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: COUNT_OF_DISC_INV_INST
columns.description: Count of the payment schedules (installments) with earned or unearned discounts applied to Invoices for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date

columns.name: LARGEST_INV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount corresponding to the largest invoice for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: LARGEST_INV_DATE
columns.description: Transaction date corresponding to the largest invoice for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: LARGEST_INV_CUST_TRX_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the largest invoice for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: DAYS_CREDIT_GRANTED_SUM
columns.description: Summation of the product of amount_due_original and difference of the due_date and trx_date, i.e., (amount_due_original * (due_date - trx_date)), for the payment schedules (installments) of all Invoices for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: NSF_STOP_PAYMENT_COUNT
columns.description: Count of all cash receipts having a status of Reversed with a Reversal Category of Non Sufficient Funds for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: NSF_STOP_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Sum of the amount on all Cash Receipts having a status of Reversed with a Reversal Category of Non Sufficient Funds for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
